Third-party software in driver_mousehmd.dll
===========================================

driver_mousehmd.dll contains code from the projects below. mousehmd itself
is under the MIT License in LICENSE.

The DLL also needs the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (MSVCP140.dll and
VCRUNTIME140.dll). It is not included here: SteamVR itself needs the same
runtime, so it is already installed wherever SteamVR runs.


1. OpenVR SDK driver header
---------------------------

cpp/openvr_driver.h from Valve's OpenVR SDK 2.15.6.
Copyright (c) 2015, Valve Corporation
BSD-3-Clause. The full license text is in OPENVR_LICENSE.txt.
